d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Sales Assistant is instrumental in driving sales and creating a welcoming environment that ensures a positive customer experience. They are responsible for providing personalized service to each customer, contributing to sales growth, and executing daily store operations as directed by the store management team. Success in this role is measured by sales results, customer satisfaction scores, and the consistent ability to maintain store presentation standards.
q: Ability to provide exceptional customer service

What Qualifies You For The Role
1-2 years of fashion retail sales experience

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

d: The Site Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all construction activities comply with the project's technical specifications, quality standards, safety regulations, and scheduled timelines.
Interpret and monitor project drawings and specifications to ensure construction activities align with contract requirements and Ministry/industry standards
Assist in developing method statements and ensure adherence to approved methodologies during execution
Ensure accurate survey control is established and maintained to ensure works are constructed to the correct line and level, in coordination with surveyors
Verify that all materials used on-site comply fully with project specifications
Monitor daily construction activities against approved drawings, specifications and project schedules
Prepare and submit inspection requests to the consultant and coordinate required inspections
Coordinate with utility authorities and relevant stakeholders before commencing excavation and diversion works
Monitor earthworks, compaction tests, concrete tests, asphalt testing and other required quality tests
Coordinate with specialist subcontractors, and the supply of materials and equipment
Optimize resource usage and minimize material wastage to enhance project profitability
Plan and organize work efficiently to meet project deadlines and milestones
Ensure that all construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved method statements and ITPs
Identify site constraints, technical issues and discrepancies in drawings and coordinate timely resolution
Promote and maintain a safe and healthy work environment in compliance with safety regulations
Monitor subcontractor performance, manpower productivity and equipment utilisation
Maintain daily site diaries and provide accurate progress reports to the Senior Engineer
Perform additional duties as assigned by management
Ensure that completed works are properly measured, recorded and reflected in as-built drawings
Carry out regular inspections of temporary works, including formwork, shoring, excavation support and other temporary structures, when appointed as Temporary Works Coordinator.
